development_donors.note: These donors motivate the test only; they are not prospective evidence.

prospective_tests.matched_geometry_reversal: Hold structural migration geometry approximately fixed; vary consumer/coexistence context; predict preserve-vs-retire compatibility action.
prospective_tests.matched_context_discrimination: Hold deployment/maintenance context approximately fixed; vary structural coordinate; predict different intervention family.
prospective_tests.interaction_nonseparability: Test whether action requires an X×G interaction term rather than independent lookup of X and G.
prospective_tests.transport: Test the frozen rule on a fresh project/topology.
prospective_tests.missing_coordinate_reopen: Only reopen if materially identical (X,G,E) still maps to distinct actions.

r2_gate: R2 only if same (X,G,E) aliases distinct actions or if nonseparability cannot be represented inside Pi without changing LAW-R1 state ontology.
